description: Open a paid link. Without a payment signature you get the x402 v2 payment requirements; send them back signed to get the destination. Already paid, or your own link (signed in as that wallet: token, or a SIGN-IN-WITH-X header signed over this link's challenge)? You get the destination directly. Taken-down links return status 410 with a machine-readable reason. PAYMENT TAKES TWO SIGNATURES: (1) call without payment → isError result whose structuredContent is the x402 PaymentRequired; (2) sign one accepts[] entry (main leg, to the creator) AND the extensions["platform-fee"].accepts[] entry on the same network (0.3% fee leg, to URLGate), same wallet; (3) call again with both: params._meta["x402/payment"] + params._meta["x402/payment-fee"] (PaymentPayload objects) or the arguments paymentSignature + paymentSignatureFee (base64). Only the main leg → refused with fee_leg_missing before anything is charged. Balance must cover BOTH legs (else insufficient_funds, charged:false). If an earlier payment settled only one leg, the result has code partial_payment, partial { paid, owed } and accepts[] with ONLY the owed leg: sign that one and send it alone (fee owed: x402/payment-fee or paymentSignatureFee). Settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. Test your client for free first with payment_compat_check. The preview testnet test link REQUIRES a wallet with Base Sepolia testnet + test USDC. If your wallet can't use testnet, follow the production path: run payment_compat_check on production (verify-only, no funds move) and, if you meet the two-signature requirements, proceed with the real paid tools.

paymentSignature.description: MAIN leg: base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for an accepts[] entry (same as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment"], which wins when both are sent. Omit on the first call to get the payment requirements.

paymentSignatureFee.description: FEE leg (open_link only, REQUIRED when the requirements have extensions["platform-fee"]): base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload for the extensions["platform-fee"].accepts[] entry on the same network, signed by the same wallet (same as PAYMENT-SIGNATURE-FEE). Fallback for params._meta["x402/payment-fee"]. Without it the call is refused with fee_leg_missing and nothing is charged. Sent ALONE when a partial payment owes only the platform fee (code partial_payment).

token.description: Session token (Bearer) when the MCP connection cannot carry an Authorization header

name: open_link
title: Open (pay for) a link
